## Optional Bioinformatics Tools

These tools are separate from the numbered assignments and have no assignment points or Canvas submission. The Advanced Tool pair is designed to be run in order.

- [Advanced Tool 1 — Build a taxon-directed proteome library](https://colab.research.google.com/github/RobBurnap/Bioinformatics-MICR4203-MICR5203/blob/main/tools/Advanced_Tool_01_Proteome_Library_Builder.ipynb)
- [Advanced Tool 2 — Search the local library with taxon-directed BLAST](https://colab.research.google.com/github/RobBurnap/Bioinformatics-MICR4203-MICR5203/blob/main/tools/Advanced_Tool_02_Taxon_Directed_BLAST_Search.ipynb)
- [Tool — Trim a protein alignment with ClipKIT](https://colab.research.google.com/github/RobBurnap/Bioinformatics-MICR4203-MICR5203/blob/main/tools/Tool_Protein_Alignment_Trimming_with_ClipKIT.ipynb)

See the [Tools guide](https://github.com/RobBurnap/Bioinformatics-MICR4203-MICR5203/blob/main/tools/README.md) for the full workflow, setup, Drive paths, and troubleshooting.
